events.title: Start Stacking! Cats and Hats DEMO is LIVE!
events.summary: Hey folks! It's finally time! Cats and Hats DEMO is out now. We decided not to gate anything, so you’ll have full access to 3 Cats, 150 tiles and over 100 hats! Thats hours and hours of content! We’ve been pouring so much love and joy into this game, we can’t wait for you to try it! Of course, in typical Spider Nest Games fashion, we’ll be hotfixing and patching any issues around the clock.
